subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Google wants to make sure that the information it suggests is **__authentic__** and comes from the experts in that niche.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"authentic"** means something that is genuine, real, and trustworthy; it is based on facts and reality. (प्रामाणिक)

 
 
• **Example: **She provided **authentic** documents to prove her identity.
 
 
 
• **"Corrupt" **refers to something that is morally degenerate, dishonest, or tainted. It usually implies a deviation from integrity and purity. (भ्रष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The official was dismissed due to his** corrupt** practices.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'authentic' **is **'corrupt'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accurate **(सटीक): Free from errors or mistakes; precise.

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist provided accurate data in his report.
 
 
 
• **Factual **(तथ्यात्मक): Based on facts; real and actual.
 
 
• **Example: **His argument was supported by factual evidence.
 
 
 
• **Pure** (शुद्ध): Free from contamination or impurities; clean.
 
 
• **Example:** The mountain air is pure and refreshing.
 
 

32:Tb96,

The correct answer is: Option 3.</
